trades.thesis: Brazil-wide pre-market surge (NU +11.7%, ITUB +17.7%, XP +19.5%, EWZ +14.3% on 14% of an average day), cause unknown. Brazilian banks fell 20% on 10/26 (probably the election result) and drifted down for 4 weeks, so this is a relief or regime re-rating. NU is a $60B eligible proxy with 0.1% slippage. Small test of continuation, price/volume only.
